caption: Performance comparisons of four various prompts of HDM in humour, fluency and coherency, marked by V1, V2, V3 and V4. The y-axis is the score on the GEMBA-SQM.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates performance comparisons of four different prompts, labeled V1, V2, V3, and V4, as measured by the GEMBA-SQM score for fluency. The categories, V1 through V4, are displayed along the horizontal axis in an unspecified order. The vertical axis represents the GEMBA-SQM fluency score, labeled accordingly, with a linear scale ranging from 97.0 to 100.0 in intervals of 0.5. A blue bar represents V1 with a height corresponding to a value of approximately 99.15. V2 is represented by an orange bar reaching a value of about 98.2, while V3 is shown as a green bar extending to approximately 98.5. Finally, V4 is represented by a purple bar with a height of around 97.7. No bars are visually emphasized, and the chart does not feature grouping or stacking.
